articles.title: Oil prices could fall to $60: Will petrol and diesel get cheaper for the common man?
articles.titleEn: Oil prices could fall to $60: Will petrol and diesel get cheaper for the common man?
articles.summary: Mark Matthews of Julius Baer predicts crude oil prices may drop to $60 a barrel amid geopolitical concerns. While higher supply from Gulf producers could stabilise prices, sustained low prices are unlikely. The impact on consumers may be limited due to taxes and refinery costs in India.
